dedupe_keys.name: gares du reseau ferroviaire gere par la region bretagne

description: Gares du réseau ferroviaire géré par la région Bretagne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Bretagne. Points d'arrêts associés aux lignes ferroviaires bretonnes. La donnée contient quelques renseignements sur la localisation et les différents services proposés pour chaque arrêt. Coverage: Région Bretagne. The publisher named on the listing is Région Bretagne. Its keywords include gare, bretagne, 233500016, point-arret, transport-ferroviaire, mobilite-transport-transport-ferroviaire. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2016-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
